title: ふたりの星囲い
concept: 二人で交互に点の間を結び、四辺が閉じた部屋の星を取る。部屋を取ると続けて線を引けるが、雲の部屋は二点失う。相手に三辺を渡すか、減点の雲を先に引き受けて連続で星を取るか、最後の一本を譲り合う駆け引きを核にした。
howToPlay: 二人で交互に点の間をタップ。四辺を閉じるとその部屋の点を獲得してもう一手。雲は−2点。全て囲んだら高得点の人が勝ち。
libraryDecision: 点・辺・部屋の関係を一目で見比べることが核。Canvasの平面描画が適し、物理や3Dの動きは囲みの判定を曖昧にするため使わない。
soundDecision: 手番ごとに高さの違う短音、星獲得は高音、雲は低音で結果を区別する。対話しながら考える二人の邪魔をしないようBGMは付けない。

candidates.idea: 二人で交互に部屋を囲う。星で加点、雲で減点、囲うと連続手番になる陣取り。
candidates.ideaEn: Two players enclose rooms: stars score, clouds cost points, and completed rooms grant another turn.

candidates.idea: 磁石を置いて玉の軌道を曲げ、遠い穴へ届ける。
candidates.ideaEn: Place magnets to bend a ball toward a distant pocket.

candidates.idea: 水面を押して蓮の高さをそろえ、橋をつくる。
candidates.ideaEn: Press water down to align lotus pads into a bridge.

en.title: Stars for Two
en.concept: Take turns joining dots and claim the stars inside a room when its fourth side closes. Claiming any room grants another turn, but cloud rooms cost two points. Decide whether to give away a third side or accept a cloud to continue into a chain of stars.
en.howToPlay: Two players take turns tapping between dots. Close a room to gain its points and play again. Clouds cost two points. Higher score wins when all rooms are claimed.
en.libraryDecision: Flat Canvas clearly shows dots, sides and rooms. Physics and depth would obscure enclosure decisions, so neither is used.
en.soundDecision: Different brief tones mark each player, stars and clouds. No music competes with two players talking through their decisions.

aiReview.comment: 両プレイヤーを自分で操作し11手を画像で確認。通常の交代、共有辺での部屋獲得、1点・2点・雲−2点、獲得後の連続手番、全室完了で3対2の勝敗、タップ再開を確認した。実際の人間二人の対戦は未検証。雲による逆転はあるが基本はDots and Boxesの小盤面。結果画面下部が白い空欄となり再開案内が見えない不具合がある。操作は動くため、手順の非致命的不具合として修正せず記録した。

similar.title: Dots-n-Boxes / Dots and Boxes
similar.note: 交互に辺を引き、最後の辺で部屋を取ると続けて手番という核が同じ。本作は1点・2点・−2点を混在させる小盤面で、AI対戦はない。
similar.note_en: Identical core: alternate edges, claim boxes on the fourth side and play again. This version uses a small mixed-value board with one, two and minus-two points and no AI opponent.

aiReview.research: Web検索を2件実施し、Chris CalabroのDots-n-Boxes作者ページで基本ルールを確認。負点変種の検索は確認不足だったため、雲の減点そのものを独自発明とは主張しない。

en.comment: Controlled both players and viewed eleven steps. Verified turns, shared edges, one/two-point and minus-two cloud rooms, extra turns, a three-to-two final result and tap restart. No real two-person match was tested. Clouds permit reversals, but this is a small Dots and Boxes variant. The bottom result panel becomes blank and hides the restart instruction. Restart works; recorded the non-fatal display bug without a post-play fix, following the procedure.
en.research: Ran two web searches and verified rules on Chris Calabro’s creator page. The search did not establish a specific negative-value variant, so no claim that cloud penalties are an original invention is made.

aiReview.method: スマホ縦画面で 11 手プレイ（時間を止めて1手ずつ操作）
aiReview.methodEn: Played 11 moves on a portrait phone screen (time frozen between moves)

playLog.note: 二人交互、囲うと連続手番、雲は減点という説明を読んで開始する。
playLog.noteEn: Read the alternating turns, extra turns for rooms and cloud penalty, then start.

playLog.note: 左上は1点。交互に上・左・下の三辺を引き、囲む前の手番変化を見る。
playLog.noteEn: The upper-left room is worth one. Alternate its top, left and bottom sides and inspect the next turn.

playLog.note: 三辺で2人目の番。右の最後の辺を閉じて星を取る。
playLog.noteEn: Three sides leave player two to move. Close the right side to claim the star.

playLog.note: 2人目が1点取り連続手番。上中央の残る三辺を交互に閉じ、共有辺の部屋も取れるか見る。
playLog.noteEn: Player two gains one and keeps the turn. Alternate the upper-middle room’s three remaining sides.

playLog.note: 上中央も2人目が獲得して2点。右上の1点の部屋を三辺で囲む。
playLog.noteEn: Player two now has two. Alternate the three remaining sides of the upper-right one-point room.

playLog.note: 上段は2人目が3点。左中央の1点を囲み、残った中央と雲へ進む準備をする。
playLog.noteEn: Player two has three. Close the middle-left one-point room before the center and cloud.

playLog.note: 中央は上と左が既にある。2人目が下を引き、1人目が右を閉じて初めて点を取る。
playLog.noteEn: Center already has top and left sides. Player two draws below; player one closes the right for a first point.

playLog.note: 右中央は雲−2。1人目が下、2人目が右を閉じ、減点しても手番が続くか見る。
playLog.noteEn: The middle-right cloud costs two. Player one draws below; player two closes right to check the penalty and extra turn.

playLog.note: 2人目は4から2点に減り手番は続いた。左下の2点を囲み直して取り戻す。
playLog.noteEn: Player two falls from four to two and retains the turn. Close the lower-left two-point room.

playLog.note: 残る2点と−2点の部屋には二辺ずつ残る。中央下は1人目が閉じ、右下は2人目が閉じる順で全盤面を終える。
playLog.noteEn: Each remaining room needs two sides. Alternate to give the lower-middle two points to player one and the lower-right cloud to player two, completing the board.

playLog.note: 最終得点3対2で1人目の勝ち。結果の下部が白い空欄で再開案内が見えない。待って画面をタップし再開できるか試す。
playLog.noteEn: Player one wins three to two. The bottom result panel is blank and hides the restart instruction. Wait and tap to test restart.

metrics.method: Codexのtoken_usage_recordをresponse_idで重複除去し企画開始から自己判定完了まで集計。入力はキャッシュ込み、出力から思考を控除。ツールはトップレベル呼出のみ。
metrics.methodEn: Aggregated unique Codex response usage from planning through review. Input includes cached tokens; output excludes reasoning; tools count top-level calls.
